name: Souvenirs of Death
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad.  So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself?  You see I am collecting human skulls.  And you will be fighting humans for quite some time.  Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
narrative.objectives: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.
narrative.offerRewardText: Precious skulls! So beautiful! I owe you as promised, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText:
So the lucky adventurer returns? How many humans have you slaughtered today? Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 24 to 25, 4,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
